text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo!
Full of energy today as always, I see~!

text_block_list.name: Free Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Palmer!
Listen to this, would ya~~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out and about, I stopped by the freestyle racecourse,
and an Umamusume who seemed to be a friend came running over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as Mejiro Palmer finished chatting with her friend and was about to leave—

text_block_list.name: Tracen Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the course is literally on the streets.
Isn't it kinda bumpy?
Can people actually run on this?

text_block_list.name: Tracen Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: No way, count me out. Feels like I'd ruin my legs.

text_block_list.name: Free Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...What do you guys want?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, sorry Trainer!
Do you mind if I head back for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo!
You girls are from Tracen Academy, right?
Is this your first time coming here?

text_block_list.name: Tracen Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...What's your deal all of a sudden?
Wait, aren't you a Mejiro? Hanging around small fry like this is only gonna make you weak.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Small fry"... huh. I don't think it's fair to assume
someone's weak just because they run solo.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Actually, running here is what made me stronger, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: No way, it's obviously way better to just train at the academy!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, training against amateurs
won't do me any good anyway!

text_block_list.name: Free Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wha, you guys—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, if you're going that far, let's settle it with a match!
That's the easiest way to figure it out, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She spoke in a tone that brooked no argument.
Swept up in her momentum,
the other two Umamusume accepted the challenge as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was tasked with acting as the referee—
and with everyone looking on,
the race began!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Right from the start, Mejiro Palmer took the lead without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, as expected of Tracen Academy students.
They keep up with the fast pace without flinching."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the excitement surged,
Mejiro Palmer kept running at the front with all her might, and then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaahhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Free Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Hell yeahhh!!
Palmer, you're the absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah... What was with that escape pace...!
That was way too reckless... completely absurd...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's not the kind of running
they usually teach you at the academy, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Still, this is the Front Running that everyone taught me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the contest was settled,
Mejiro Palmer received a standing ovation for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps sensing something from the scene,
the two Tracen Academy Umamusume
awkwardly took their leave.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, sorry!
Looks like I dragged you into a fight.
choice_data_list: There really are all kinds of front runners, huh.
There really are all kinds of front runners, huh.
You're so thoughtful of your friends, huh.
You're so thoughtful of your friends.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, sorry!
Looks like I dragged you into a fight.

You're so thoughtful of your friends, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told her that running away at full speed to protect her friend looked really cool.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, about earlier? No, no,
it really wasn't that big a deal!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: We finally have a place where we can run freely, so I just thought using it for fighting was a waste.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Besides, look—all I'm doing is running away, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her shy smile looked prouder than usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that's kinda embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you're right.
I'm who I am today thanks to them.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The growth you experience and the things you gain in that place—
I don't want anyone to dismiss that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then, she shared many stories
about her friends with me."
